note: Possible spam: repositories that reuse the name of a project in this guide but are not that project. Each row states only what the repository itself shows on the date in `checked`. Nothing here was downloaded or analysed, and a row is not a malware verdict; it means the build cannot be traced to the upstream source. Remove a row when the repository is gone or proves its link to upstream.
